title: DARE: Aligning LLM Agents with the R Statistical Ecosystem via Distribution-Aware Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2603.04743v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents excel at automating data science workflows, yet often underutilize rigorous statistical methods in R. Existing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) approaches rely on semantic similarity, ignoring the data-distribution and structural characteristics crucial for determining a statistical method's applicability. To address this, we propose DARE (Distribution-Aware Retrieval Embedding), a representation learning framework incorporating these data characteristics into R function retrieval. Our contributions are fourfold: (i) RPKB, a curated knowledge base of 8,191 high-quality R functions; (ii) DARE, the distribution-aware retrieval framework; (iii) RCodingAgent, an R-oriented agent integrating DARE for end-to-end analysis; and (iv) RStatBench, a comprehensive benchmark of 100 statistical tasks. Experiments demonstrate that DARE improves NDCG@10 by 13.43 to 32.65 percentage points across evaluated

translated_title: DARE：通过分布感知检索实现大语言模型智能体与R统计生态系统的对齐
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体在自动化数据科学工作流程方面表现出色，但往往未能充分利用R语言中严谨的统计方法。现有的检索增强生成（RAG）方法依赖于语义相似性，忽略了对确定统计方法适用性至关重要的数据分布和结构特征。为解决这一问题，我们提出了DARE（分布感知检索嵌入），这是一个将这些数据特征融入R函数检索的表示学习框架。我们的贡献有四个方面：（i）RPKB，一个包含8,191个高质量R函数的精选知识库；（ii）DARE，分布感知检索框架；（iii）RCodingAgent，一个面向R语言的智能体，集成DARE实现端到端分析；（iv）RStatBench，一个包含100个统计任务的综合基准。实验表明，DARE在评估中将NDCG@10提升了13.43至32.65个百分点。
tldr: 该论文提出DARE框架，通过将数据分布和结构特征融入R函数检索的表示学习，使LLM智能体能够更准确地为数据分析匹配合适的R统计方法，并配套构建了知识库、智能体和基准测试。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes DARE, a distribution-aware retrieval embedding framework that incorporates data distribution and structural characteristics into R function retrieval, enabling LLM agents to accurately match appropriate R statistical methods for data analysis, along with a curated knowledge base, an R-oriented coding agent, and a comprehensive benchmark.
